name: choc-switch
title: Kailh Choc v1 switch on a board (reference)
orientation: Not printed: a model of the switch to check fits against, soldered to a board without a plate. The board's top is z = 0.

bottom.rule: Bottom housing, square (it passes a 14 mm plate cut-out)
bottom.source: Kailh PG1350 drawing, as quoted by low-profile keyboard guides (13.8 mm bottom housing); measure a switch

bottom_h.rule: Bottom housing's height, the board to the plate's underside: estimate, measure a switch

housing_top.rule: Top of the housing, where the stem comes out

stem_h.rule: The stem's posts above the housing: its 3 mm of travel, estimate

stem_top.rule: Top of the stem above the board

post_x.rule: Each stem post from the centre (5.7 mm apart, as Choc keycaps' sockets): estimate

centre_d.rule: The centre post, a little under its hole

post_below.rule: The centre post's length into the board
